intel.overview: Postman is an AI-native API platform that enables developers to design, build, test, manage, and distribute APIs and services at enterprise scale. It provides a collaborative environment for engineers to streamline the entire API lifecycle.
intel.target_audience: Software engineers and development teams building, testing, and managing APIs, as well as enterprises seeking API governance and collaboration.

intel.overview: Supabase provides an open‑source Postgres‑based development platform that adds authentication, real‑time APIs, storage, edge functions, and vector embeddings, allowing developers to build full‑stack applications quickly. It scales from a weekend prototype to millions of users while remaining transparent, self‑hostable, and community‑driven.
intel.target_audience: Developers and product teams building web, mobile, or AI applications who need a scalable, open‑source backend platform with built‑in auth, database, realtime, and storage capabilities.

intel.overview: Vapi provides a unified, API‑first platform for building, testing, and deploying voice agents at enterprise scale, handling infrastructure, monitoring, and compliance. It enables companies to launch voice AI quickly, track performance, and maintain high‑quality customer experiences.
intel.target_audience: Enterprises and development teams building voice AI agents and conversational phone experiences, especially those needing scalability, compliance, and dedicated support.
